jd:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.


As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.


We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.


This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.


We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.


Join us and let’s shape the future of data.



Job Description


We’re the embedded HDD firmware crew that keeps the world’s data spinning. Our SAFe agile squads write C++ firmware, build Python test tools, and dive deep into RTOS-level code that ships in enterprise-class hard-disk drives. You’ll pair up with hardware engineers, SIT, and QA partners around the globe to turn specs into rock-solid products.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:



- Code that ships: Design, code, and debug C++ firmware running on real HDD platforms. 
- Build the toolbox: Create Python-based test utilities that accelerate our CI pipeline. 
- Own the sprint: Contribute inside a SAFe agile team—story pointing, stand-ups, demos, repeat. 
- See the system: Explore registers, buses, and RTOS internals to hunt down bugs and optimize performance. 
- Share the story: Document designs, results, and data insights so everyone learns. 
- Daily Programming Languages:  C++ & Python 
This role is part of WD's early career development program. WD's early career development program is ideal for individuals at the early stages of their professional career.  Participants receive foundational training through structured onboarding, mentorship, and a curated development curriculum. The responsibilities of this role are typically aligned with candidates who have approximately 0–2+ years of relevant professional experience, though candidates of all experience levels are encouraged to apply.



Qualifications


REQUIRED



- Class standing:  Currently pursuing a BS in CS, CE, EE, or similar. 
- Fluent in code: Solid projects or coursework in C++ and Python. 
- Embedded mindset: You’ve tinkered with microcontrollers, RTOS kernels, or low-level drivers. 
- Team energy: Collaborative, curious, and comfortable asking “why?” 
- Communicator: Clear writer and speaker—because great ideas deserve great explanations. 
PREFERRED



- Past internship or personal projects in embedded/IoT. 
- Familiarity with ESP32, I2C, SATA/SAS bus analyzers, or automated test frameworks.

role: AI Engineering Intern - Full-time Internship (Jan - June 2027)
jd: Who we are looking for We are looking for a motivated AI Engineering Intern to join the our team. The candidate will work with experienced engineers to design, develop, and test end-to-end AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). This is a hands-on engineering role for students who are passionate about AI and interested in turning emerging AI technologies into practical applications. What you will be responsible for The candidate will be involved in: Design and develop LLM-powered applications and AI agents using Python. Work on key components of end-to-end AI solutions, including prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agent workflows, tool integration, and APIs. Explore and evaluate AI frameworks and technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, vector databases, and LLM APIs. Write clean, maintainable code and develop unit tests to ensure solution quality and reliability. Participate in debugging, testing, and performance improvement of AI applications. Collaborate with senior developers, QA engineers, and other team members throughout the software development lifecycle. Research and experiment with new AI/LLM technologies and contribute ideas to prototypes and production solutions. What we value Strong interest in AI, Large Language Models, and Agentic AI. Solid problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies quickly. Ability to work with senior developers on AI application development, testing, and troubleshooting. Hands-on mindset and curiosity about how AI systems work beyond simply calling an LLM API. Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within an engineering team. Education & Preferred Qualifications Currently pursuing a BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Good programming skills in Python. Basic understanding of software engineering concepts, including APIs, Git, unit testing, and debugging. Basic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI concepts. Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: LangChain / LangGraph or similar AI frameworks RAG and vector databases Prompt engineering Cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure Machine Learning / NLP Previous AI/LLM projects, coursework, hackathons, or open-source contributions are a plus, but not required. Most importantly, a strong passion for AI and eagerness to learn and build. Salary Range: $41,600 - $65,000 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.
